text: Paper and book atlas / 2006 The Birth of Molecular Clouds: Formation of Atomic Precursors in Colliding Flows Heitsch, Slyz, Devriendt, Hartmann & Burkert · 2006 ApJ 648, 1052–1065 Reference listed · scope proposed Colliding atomic flows develop structure through dynamical and thermal instabilities before molecular hydrogen begins to form. Scope in this archive. Document the inflow, cooling law, geometry, and instability diagnostics. Prefer reanalysis of available density/temperature and fragmentation outputs; do not require a full multidimensional rerun or imply that this model follows the molecular stage.
